notes: Independence check vs S.N. 100 IKEA UK (c100.json) and S.N. 117 IKEA DE (c117.json): confirmed GENUINELY SEPARATE. IKEA runs one global platform (shared sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com PRIMARY_AREA API and shared numeric category-ID scheme across country storefronts) but each locale has its own market-specific catalog/pricing/qty. Verified independence three ways: (1) locale path https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/ is the genuine French storefront (direct fetch HTTP 200, EUR pricing, IKEA PS 2026 current-season products present, French-language nav/UI, no shutdown language); (2) queried the fr/fr market endpoint (sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/fr/fr/search) and every single leaf qty differs from both the UK and DE figures (e.g. Floor Lamps: UK=40, DE=46, FR=45; Ceiling Lights: UK=106, DE=105, FR=95; LED Lights: UK=110, DE=99, FR=91; Flower Pots & Planters: UK=138, DE=155, FR=105) -- no two-country qty match found anywhere in the 58-row set; (3) each leaf category's own FR-language canonical slug was independently re-derived by following the site's own redirect from the bare category ID (not assumed from the UK/DE slug lists), e.g. lampadaires-10731, miroirs-muraux-24858, horloges-murales-et-de-table-10785. This is the 3rd data point for the IKEA per-country pattern (UK/DE/FR all genuinely independent), extending the project's 2-for-2 precedent to 3-for-3. Category-ID parity with UK/DE is 1:1 (same 58 leaf category IDs resolve on the FR site), expected under IKEA's single global platform and independently confirmed here (not assumed) via the redirect-slug + API-query sweep plus a manual nav sweep of every FR hub page (Eclairage/Lighting, Decoration hub, Miroirs/Mirrors, Vases et coupes, Bougies/Candles, Horloges/Clocks, Cadres et affiches/Frames, Arts de la table/Kitchen&Dining) which surfaced no FR-only categories beyond this set and no missing ones. TWO scoping/labelling divergences were found and followed rather than assumed, both cross-checked against product-title samples via the API: (a) category 10785 is 'Horloges murales et de table' (Wall & Table Clocks) on FR -- matching DE's broader 'Wand- & Tischuhren' scope, NOT the UK's narrower pure 'Wall Clocks' label -- confirmed IN SCOPE either way (clocks). (b) category 24861 is 'Miroirs decoratifs' (Decorative Mirrors) on FR -- matching the UK's 'Decorative Mirrors' label, NOT DE's narrower 'Small Mirrors' (Kleine Spiegel) label for the same numeric ID -- a genuine 3-way per-market naming split on one shared category ID, each site's own page title used as the source of truth rather than copying either sibling's label. Also checked and confirmed IN-SCOPE (not a holiday exclusion) despite an unusual FR-only page title: category 14971 is titled 'Eclairage saisonnier interieur et exterieur' (Seasonal indoor/outdoor lighting) on FR vs UK/DE's 'Decorative Lighting' -- pulled a 30-item product sample via the API (SOLVINDEN, LEDFYR, KUSTFYR LED string lights/light decorations etc) and confirmed it is the same decorative-LED-lighting category as the UK/DE Decorative Lighting node, not a Christmas/holiday-only listing, so it is kept as 'Decorative Lighting' for naming consistency with the sibling rows. Access route: direct fetch of ikea.com/fr/fr/ pages worked with no blocking encountered. Category IDs and hierarchy scaffolded from the confirmed-global 58-category scheme shared with S.N. 100/117, then independently re-verified for FR: reverse-engineered the sik.search request body from a public sample script (searchParameters.type=CATEGORY, components[0].component=PRIMARY_AREA, window.offset/size, POST with a stable Session-Id header) since a naive JSON payload guess returned HTTP 400. IMPORTANT correction to the UK/DE methodology found on FR: the raw metadata.max field is NOT reliable as a boundary anchor on its own -- it fluctuated between 44/45/46 for the same category (Floor Lamps) across different window sizes/refetches because it also counts a non-product PLANNER breakout card (an 'IKEA Kreativ' room-planner promo tile) that sik.search sometimes splices into the PRIMARY_AREA item stream at a fixed position. Fixed methodology: qty = metadata.itemsPerType.PRODUCT, independently cross-checked against the unique count of type=='PRODUCT' items (by itemNoGlobal) from a full window=999 fetch (always matched), then boundary-tested at offset=qty-1 (returned the final product) and offset=qty (returned an empty PRIMARY_AREA result set) -- all 58 categories passed this corrected exhaustion+boundary check cleanly, plus a same-window refetch reproduced an identical qty every time (ruling out A/B-test-bucket qty flicker once Session-Id was pinned per category). Excluded per standing rules, all confirmed present on the FR nav during the sweep: Ampoules (light bulbs), Abat-jour/pieds/cables (lamp shades/bases/cords -- hardware parts); Bougies parfumees (scented candles) and Parfums d'ambiance (home fragrance/diffusers/pot-pourri); Plantes et fleurs and fleurs artificielles coupees (living and artificial plants/flowers -- only the empty decorative Pots/cache-pots/jardinieres kept); Tableaux d'affichage (noticeboards); Papeterie et fournitures de bureau (stationery/office supplies); Boites de rangement et paniers (storage boxes/baskets); Meubles hauts avec miroir (mirror cabinets -- storage furniture with a mirror door, same basis as UK/DE's mirror-cabinet exclusion); Accessoires bougies (candle snuffers/tools -- functional accessory, not a holder); Etageres (shelving furniture); all kitchen-utensil/cookware/cutlery/bakeware/dishwashing/vacuum-flask/coffee-machine/straw-and-bar-tool categories under Arts de la table -- functional/appliance, out of scope, mirroring the UK/DE exclusion list exactly. All *-serie collection pages (ARSTID, NYMANE, HEKTAR, NAEVLINGE, SKURUP, SIMRISHAMN, RODALM, FEJKA, PJATTERYD, IKEA PS 2026, etc) are marketing/collection pages, not categories, skipped per the standing 'Collections' exclusion. Rule 0 applied: Bathroom Lighting (10736), Outdoor Lighting (17897), Bathroom Mirrors (20490) and Vanity Mirrors (20498) all INCLUDED as room-qualified branches of the type trees (Lighting, Mirrors) they belong to. Rule 0.6 overlap: as on UK/DE, Mirrors presents both a shape/type cross-cut (Large/Wall/Round/Standing/Decorative) and a room/use cross-cut (Vanity/Bathroom/Makeup mirrors, Mirrors with Lights) as separate site-curated category IDs; both trees emitted in full, overlap documented here rather than dropped. Lighting similarly mixes a fixture-type tree (Ceiling/Table/Floor/Wall/Desk/Children's/Spotlights/Smart/LED/Rechargeable/Pendant) with a room/use tree (Decorative/Integrated/Smart/Outdoor/Bathroom lighting) at the same level; both kept.
